summary: The 2026 AI coding landscape is dominated by a few mature platforms: GitHub Copilot remains the broadest by install base, while Cursor and Claude Code have become the fast-growing favorites among professional developers for agentic editing and autonomous code reasoning. The market has consolidated around multi-model, agent-capable tools that integrate into IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD, with vendor-specific agents (OpenAI Codex, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist) and the rebranded Devin (formerly Windsurf/Codeium) rounding out the top tier.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
strengths: Largest developer install base and ecosystem
Agent Mode for multi-step autonomous changes
Widest multi-model selector (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, GPT models)
Deep GitHub/PR/CI integration with cloud agents that open PRs
tools.best_for: Pragmatic default for teams already on GitHub wanting broad IDE and workflow coverage

tools.name: Cursor
strengths: Default AI IDE for everyday shipping
Fast inline diffs with developer-approved edits
In-editor model switching across multiple providers plus Grok and Composer
Strong codebase-aware context and agent workflows
tools.best_for: Developers who want an AI-native editor for daily feature development

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing_paid: Included in Claude Pro $20/mo and Max $100-200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Strongest coding and reasoning 'brain'
High agentic autonomy — plans, edits files, runs shell commands
Excellent at large multi-file refactors and complex debugging
Terminal-first workflow with IDE integrations
tools.best_for: Complex autonomous coding tasks requiring deep reasoning

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.pricing_paid: Included with ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, Pro $200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Cloud-based agentic coding with parallel task execution
Deep integration with ChatGPT and GPT-5 class models
CLI and IDE extension for delegating tasks
Strong code generation and test-writing capabilities
tools.best_for: Delegating well-scoped coding tasks to an autonomous cloud agent

tools.name: Gemini Code Assist
strengths: Generous free tier with high completion limits
Large context window powered by Gemini models
Deep Google Cloud and Firebase integration
Agent mode and CLI support
tools.best_for: Developers in the Google Cloud ecosystem wanting a strong free tier

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
strengths: Deep AWS service integration and infrastructure awareness
Agentic code transformation and Java/.NET upgrades
Security scanning and remediation built in
Strong free tier for individual developers
tools.best_for: Teams building and modernizing on AWS infrastructure

tools.name: Devin Desktop
strengths: Fully autonomous software engineering agent
Formerly Windsurf/Codeium technology now unified under Devin
Handles end-to-end tasks: planning, coding, testing, PRs
Parallel agent execution across tasks
tools.best_for: Delegating complete engineering tasks to an autonomous agent

tools.name: JetBrains AI Assistant
tools.pricing_paid: AI Pro $10/mo, AI Ultimate $20/mo (bundled with IDE subscriptions)
strengths: Native deep integration across all JetBrains IDEs
Context-aware completions using IDE's code intelligence
Junie agentic coding assistant for autonomous tasks
Multi-model support
tools.best_for: Developers deeply invested in the JetBrains IDE ecosystem

tools.name: Tabnine
strengths: Privacy-first with self-hosted and air-gapped deployment
Code stays private; no retention of customer code
Custom models trained on your codebase
Enterprise compliance focus
tools.best_for: Security- and privacy-conscious enterprises needing on-prem AI coding

tools.name: RooCode
tools.pricing_paid: Free (open source); pay for your own model API usage
strengths: Reliability-first agent for large, complex changes
Open source and highly customizable with custom modes
Bring-your-own-model flexibility
Strong at big multi-file refactors
tools.best_for: Developers wanting an open, reliable agent for large-scale code changes

tools.name: Cline
tools.pricing_paid: Free (open source); pay for your own model API usage
strengths: Popular open-source autonomous coding agent in VS Code
Plan/Act modes with human-in-the-loop approval
Bring-your-own-model across many providers
Rapidly growing community adoption
tools.best_for: Developers wanting a transparent, open-source agent with model flexibility
